releases.notes:
# Minecraft Version(s): 26.3
## Changes:
- "Mobs on locator bar" now also reaches mobs that weren't loaded when the setting was changed: every 15 seconds, loaded mobs whose locator bar range doesn't match the setting yet get it once (each mob is only touched once per setting, so this stays cheap)

## Fixes:
- Mobs from chunks that were unloaded while "Mobs on locator bar" was switched off kept showing on the locator bar, which also made every player's movement more expensive for the server

releases.notes:
# Minecraft Version(s): 26.3
## Changes:
- Converted mobs (e.g. Pigs struck by lightning, grown-up Tadpoles) now get their new locator bar icon only once, when near a player, instead of all mobs being updated every 15 seconds (performance)
- Locator bar settings are now applied to all loaded mobs and village names when saving the misc settings

## Fixes:
- Rarity mobs losing their rarity locator bar icon
